name: omp-wezterm-worker
description: Spawn an independent OMP worker session inside a WezTerm pane or tab. The user watches it live while the main agent keeps working; the worker's final result is delivered back into the main session.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/transcript.test.ts tests/config.test.ts tests/runs.test.ts tests/monitor.test.ts tests/job.test.ts tests/lifecycle.test.ts tests/architecture.test.ts tests/ste100.test.ts tests/comms-check.test.ts tests/stop.test.ts tests/steer.test.ts tests/limits.test.ts tests/usage.test.ts tests/trial-report.test.ts tests/trial-paths.test.ts tests/registration.test.ts tests/launch-recovery.test.ts tests/release-ordering.test.ts tests/resource-exclusion.test.ts tests/execution-evidence.test.ts tests/report-interval.test.ts tests/legacy-resolution.test.ts tests/stop-intent.test.ts tests/second-writer.test.ts tests/report-decision.test.ts tests/recovery.test.ts tests/cycle-settling.test.ts tests/report-store.test.ts tests/backend.test.ts tests/claude-run-state.test.ts tests/spawn-backend.test.ts tests/native-usage.test.ts tests/correlation.test.ts tests/pending-events.test.ts tests/bridge-handover.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:panes && npm run test:integration:free
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run ste100 && npm run test
